W.note: Bloom glow, drifting aurora and arrow reveal on a dark gradient pill feel properly ethereal, with long soft-landing curves, focus-visible and reduced-motion handled, and the label stays legible.

X.note: Well-built and accessible with a gentle ring and soft glow, but the hover is subtle and the dark navy button barely changes, so it reads more refined than dreamlike.

Y.note: Warm halo, lift and letter-spacing shift with unhurried curves and a good focus ring, polished but restrained, and the glass button at rest has lower affordance.

Z.note: Most vivid iridescent bloom and sheen with nice overshoot, but at peak glow the white label washes out against pastel colors, hurting legibility, and the animated blur layer is heavier.
